title: Render active authored content without parent or network authority
preconditions: A Saga fixture contains interactive HTML or SVG with active script content.

steps.action: Read the active fragment through the structured interface.
steps.expected_result: The bytes are returned as inert bounded data and no script executes during the read.

steps.action: Open the interactive fragment in the reviewer.
steps.expected_result: It is served in an opaque sandbox with no parent-origin authority and a network-denying content policy.

steps.action: Request an escaping fragment asset or disallowed connection capability.
steps.expected_result: The request is rejected or blocked without exposing host files or granting network access.

expected_result: Pass when active content stays inert in reads and isolated in a network-denied opaque frame; fail if it gains parent authority, external connection authority, or path escape.
